The budget-optimal dense direction u ~ M^+g beats u ~ g on the J2 readout by a factor of 1.360-1.433 at EVERY budget from 0.05 to 0.5, 8/8 contexts and exact sign p=0.0078 at every budget; it reproduced on both registered axes (G2 out-of-sample 8/8 per budget with no overfitting penalty; G1 pooled r=0.5469/J64=0.4375, and the advantage holds in 12/12 word-half x direction-rule cells). (2) /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/sweep_ids: --record-top 64 with --ks 1, giving the coordinate identities; g verified deterministic across the two runs (abs_g_total identical, K=1 predicted 0.062199 in both). L14N8949 ranks 7/13/31/46/46/59 and is outside the top-64 in 2 of 8 contexts; L13N7956 outside the top-64 in 8/8; top-1 layer is L14 in 7/8; top-16 pooled L13 63 / L14 65; cumulative share of ||g||^2: top-1 0.279% (51.4x uniform), top-8 1.413%, top-32 3.629%, top-64 5.739% (16.5x). Committed: 07_results/support_sweep_L14_c8.{json,md}, 07_results/support_sweep_topids_c8.json.
sources.dense_optimal_run: AutoDL 4080 SUPER /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/dense_opt (scripts/dense_optimal.py, 8 contexts x 2 grad passes + 80 J2 evaluations = 160 batched forwards, 92 s, bf16). Arms: base | u_g (full support, ~g) | u_M (full support, ~M^+g = What B^-2 e) | u_g64 (top-64 PER LAYER = 128 coordinates, not the global top-64 of plan 2.20). Realized mean dJ2 at b=0.05: u_g64 +0.24054, u_g +0.36381, u_M +0.49603. Algebra validated in numpy before any GPU time: for g = What jhat the predicted optimum b*sqrt(e'B^-2 e) and the u~g gain b*||g||^2/||e|| both matched the realized gains to 6 decimals, the ratio closed form is >=1 with equality iff jhat is an eigenvector of B, and 20000 random directions at the same budget never beat it. For a g NOT in range(What) the problem is ill-posed (ratio 0.08), which is why the p50/||W|| dose convention matters. Committed: 07_results/dense_optimal_c8.{json,md}, including per-arm top-64 coordinates as layer/neuron/sign/strength.
sources.dense_transfer_run: AutoDL 4080 SUPER /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/transfer_c8 (scripts/dense_optimal.py --transfer, 139 s; 8 contexts split into trait-balanced halves A={hostility_04,risk_aversion_04,greed_04,avoidance_04} and B={hostility_05,risk_aversion_05,greed_05,avoidance_05} by alternating index because the probe file groups pairs by trait; g pooled within each half; 3 pooled directions {A,B,ALL} x 2 arms x 8 contexts x 3 budgets = 144 measurements + 8 baselines + 16 grad passes). Out-of-sample u_M > u_g in 8/8 at each budget, exact two-sided sign p = 0.0078125, median abs diff +0.12070/+0.30884/+0.43417. Honest counting recorded in plan 2.23.3: pooling the three budgets into 24/24 (p ~ 1.2e-07) would overstate independence because the budgets are nested scalings of the same two directions. Committed: 07_results/dense_transfer_c8.{json,md}.
sources.dense_g1_run: AutoDL 4080 SUPER /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/g1_c8 (scripts/dense_optimal.py --g1, 204 s; 8 contexts x 2 word halves {pos_A adj 9 + verb 7, pos_B adj 10 + verb 7, shared neutral neg} x 2 direction-building rules {per-context, pooled over all 8} x 2 arms x 3 budgets = 192 measurements + 16 baselines + 32 grad passes). Each half is measured with its OWN readout, since J2 over pos_A and J2 over pos_B are different quantities. Registered G1 gate on pooled g: r=0.5469 (need >=0.50), top-64 overlap=0.4375 (need >=0.30) -> PASS, consistent with the two historical passes (9 prompts r=0.684/J64=0.506, 19 prompts r=0.693/J64=0.524) and unlike the 6-prompt measurement (r=0.583/J64=0.267, FAIL on J64). Per-context (stricter, not the registered quantity): r median 0.4722 range 0.2846-0.6712, top-64 overlap median 0.3594 range 0.125-0.5469. Pooled direction agreement cos(u_g^A,u_g^B)=0.7356 vs cos(u_M^A,u_M^B)=0.7304. Committed: 07_results/dense_g1_c8.{json,md}.
sources.behavior_run: AutoDL 4080 SUPER /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/behav_c8 (scripts/behavior_check.py, 147 s; 8 contexts x {none, u_g, u_M} x budgets {0.05, 0.5}, 40 greedy generations of <=96 tokens + 40 capability forwards + 16 grad passes). Deliberately judge-free, because 08_reference §4.4 showed one LLM judge returning 4.297% / 7.74% / 48.156% for 'degeneration' depending on whether its category or its tags are read. Metrics: stop reason, distinct-1/2, rep4 = 1 - distinct_4grams/total_4grams, longest immediate repeat, and the capability proxy = change in teacher-forced mean logP of engine.REFERENCE_TEXT (sha256 afb86522116b9ccd...). Required a vectorised steering hook because the frozen engine.apply_steering loops over all 18432 coordinates in Python at every decode step; equivalence was verified bitwise (max |dS| = 0.0e+00) on a 10-coordinate case before any measurement, after a first attempt drifted 3.922e-02. Committed: 07_results/behavior_check_c8.{json,md}.
sources.envelope_runs: AutoDL 4080 SUPER, two runs on the same 7-budget grid {0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.3,0.4,0.5} x 8 contexts: /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/behav_envelope (scripts/behavior_check.py, 120 greedy generations of <=96 tokens + 120 capability forwards, 393 s) and /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/dense_envelope (scripts/dense_optimal.py --record-top 0, 176 J2 evaluations, 164 s). No new code was written for this round - both scripts already took --budgets, and the §2.25 criterion was reused unchanged. verdict.meaning: L14N8949 is a real, directional, dose-monotone lever that does act on the hostility readout: J2 (hostility-vs-neutral slot mass) rises +0.0059/+0.0095/+0.0191/+0.0484 over doses 0.005-0.05, positive on 6/6 held-out probes at 0.02, 8x the same-layer random control mean at 0.02 and 32x at 0.05, and the mirrored arm is negative and growing (so not a generic perturbation). What is NOT shown is exclusivity: on 3 shared contexts it never ranks first among the five hand-written trait contrasts. Two caveats keep that from being a refutation: (i) the coordinate came from one brute-force generation-based scan, i.e. a draw, not the optimum of any hostility criterion; (ii) n=3 contexts with wide per-trait spread cannot separate "not specific" from "specific but small".
verdict.S2_note: pre-registered rule not met (hostility never the max of five traits, 3/3 contexts). Power is low: 3 contexts, per-trait sd 0.011-0.044, hostility mean 0.0275 with 95% CI [-0.025, +0.080]; hostility ranks 2nd in one context (0.048 vs 0.067). So this run does not show "not hostility-specific"; it shows specificity is undemonstrated.
verdict.S2_instrument_note: The pre-registered S2 used the J1 five-trait matrix, whose five contrasts share one neutral negative; it therefore measures evaluative register, not specificity. The within-instrument test (two J2 readouts, hostile-vs-praise and praise-vs-neutral) shows the opposite of a uniform lift: h-n up, c-n down, 8/8 coordinates and dose-monotone. So S2 FAIL is an instrument result, not evidence about the coordinate.

provenance.origin: one hit from a brute-force generation-based scan (dose 1.0, persona-matrix line); recorded as KNOWN_EVIL in the package engine; NOT a maximiser of any hostility criterion
